name: settleup-server
description: No-login shared expenses for short-lived private-by-link events

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev:api:watch
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev:web:watch
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:dev:api:watch" "npm:dev:web:watch"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:server && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm run build:contracts && npm run lint --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.clean:server: node --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true })"
scripts.clean: npm run clean:server && npm run clean --workspace @settleup/contracts && npm run clean --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:contracts && npm run clean:server && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @settleup/web
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run build --workspace @settleup/web
